question.text: In the clearing and settlement process, after trade details are available from the Exchange, the next step is:

answer.text: Custodial confirmation of trades to the CC/CH by custodians/clearing members

explanation.text: The Logic: After trade details flow from the Exchange, custodians/clearing members confirm the trades to the CC/CH. The detailed T+1 flow on the source pages also includes CP-code modification and INST allocation before confirmation, followed by obligation determination and download to CMs, then pay-in and pay-out. The Trap: Settlement does not happen immediately after trading — confirmation by custodians/clearing members precedes obligation determination. Note: Custodial confirmation is performed by the custodians/clearing members to the CC/CH, not by the clearing corporation itself.
